instruction.german: Write your food diary for one day of the school week. Answer these questions:

parts:
What day of the school week is it?

What do you have for breakfast?

What do you have for lunch?

What do you have for dinner?

 

Use these words to start the sentences in your food diary:

Today is ...

For breakfast, I have ... . I drink ... .

I eat ... for lunch. I drink ... .

For dinner, I have ... . I drink ... .
